description: Dry-run one placement or up to 20 placements (session, room, start, end) without changing the schedule. Use it before schedule_session to catch clashes with accepted sessions, session people, rooms, and all-rooms breaks and plenums. Returns results[] per placement with ok, issues, itemConflicts, and normalized times, plus a flat itemConflicts list.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

placement.description: One placement with sessionId, roomId, startTime, and endTime.

name: check_schedule_conflicts

itemConflicts.description: Every placement's agenda item conflicts in one flat list.

results.description: One entry per proposed placement, in order.

endTime.description: Normalized ISO end time; write this one.

ok.description: True when the placement has no issues or item conflicts.

startTime.description: Normalized ISO start time; write this one.
